text:
marta: FYI we've seen 3 noisy auto-fallbacks this morning during quota backpressure. on-call keeps flipping rollouts back but we have zero quick context on whether that's safe.

noah: ugh. can we add a "quiet override" that is both auditable and shows a compact explain panel? ops want a quick yes/no signal + sample requests.

eli: +1. two must-haves: (1) machine-friendly reason codes on every fallback event (e.g. Fallback::Quota::Burst, Fallback::OOM, Fallback::KV::Miss) and (2) a compact preview for overrides that shows estimated delta on error-rate + p95.

marta: sketch for API we discussed:

```
POST /v1/rollouts/{rollout_id}/overrides
{
  "actor": "marta",
  "kind": "quiet-override",
  "ttl_seconds": 600,
  "safety_thresholds": { "max_err_delta": 0.04 }
}
```

noah: quick Q: safety_thresholds as freeform JSON might be fuzzy for SDKs. prefer typed params: max_error_delta, max_latency_pct.

eli: agreed, typed fields are better. server should refuse overrides that fail a quick safety check. show the reason in the UI tooltip e.g. "blocked: recent error delta 0.07 > 0.04".

opsbot: deploy scheduled: feature/quiet-override-preview -> staging @ 10:40 UTC

marta: UX: tiny control in operator console called "Quiet Override" with presets (5m / 15m / 1h), a dropdown of reasons, and an accordion "Explain" that expands to: reason-codes, top-5 error classes, 3 anonymized request samples, and a before/after metric snapshot.

sara: important: audit entry must include trace ids + preview_id so we can replay in debug sandbox later. retention for override-audits: 90 days by default, 365 days for incidents.

noah: also add a one-click "create incident" from the override modal that seeds a ticket with the audit link + preview snapshot. reduces context switch.

eli: backend idea: run the preview by sampling 5% of live traffic into a routing branch (cheap simulation), compute delta, return quick estimate. previews are asynchronous — return preview_id and stream updates to UI.

marta: safety policy: block override if (current_error - baseline) > 0.05 OR (p95_latency - baseline_p95) / baseline_p95 > 0.25. these are conservative but prevent making outages worse.

noah: limit overrides per-route to 1 active override, max ttl 3600s. also require role rollout:operator to apply, rollout:viewer sees preview only. audit logs store session id and IP.

eli: we should include a small "why this fallback triggered" widget that ranks signals (quota pressure, mem pressure, model OOM, KV miss) with weights and links to the raw event IDs. helps operators decide.

opsbot: ticket created: OPS-9187 (quiet-override + explain panel + preview runner)

marta: next: eli to prototype preview runner (sampling harness) and define preview cost budget, noah to update API schema + SDK stubs, sara to draft audit schema and retention rules. i'll mock the modal and small explain panel in figma.

noah: one more: telemetry team — please add the machine-readable fallback_reason field to the fallback event payload and include quota-window context (window_start, window_tokens, throttle_pct). that'll help clustering.

eli: experiments: roll out preview to internal-only routes for 2 weeks, measure mean time to safe-undo and # of rollback regressions (cases where undo increased errors).

marta: ok i'll post the figma by EOD and a short A/B plan. thanks all :thumbsup:
